formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO with LiMPSA (LiCF3SO2N(CH2)3OCH3). Low molecular weight PEO (Mn ~4000) used for conductivity study. High molecular weight PEO (Mn ~300,000) used for control.
formulations.VFT Notes (above temp): Read from Fig 8/9 fits; T0 = Tg - 25C used for comparison, but values vary with T.
formulations.Notes: Salt prepared in acetonitrile, dried under high vacuum. Mixtures dried under high vacuum at 130 C. LiMPSA melting point 256 C.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO with KMPSA (KCF3SO2N(CH2)3OCH3). Low molecular weight PEO (Mn ~4000) used.
formulations.VFT Notes (above temp): Read from Fig 8/9 fits; T0 = Tg - 25C used for comparison, but values vary with T.
formulations.Notes: Salt prepared in acetonitrile, dried under high vacuum at 130 C. KMPSA melting point 45 C. Miscible in all proportions with PEO at moderate temperatures.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO with LiTFSI (Li(CF3SO2)2N). High molecular weight PEO (Mn ~300,000) used for control.
formulations.VFT Notes (above temp): Read from Fig 8/9 fits; T0 = Tg - 25C used for comparison, but values vary with T.
formulations.Notes: LiTFSI dried under high vacuum at 150 C and 170 C. Contains ~1.8% water (LiTFSI-1/3H2O). Forms crystalline compounds (6/1, 3/1, 2/1) with PEO. Miscible at elevated temperatures.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO with KTFSI (K(CF3SO2)2N). Low molecular weight PEO (Mn ~4000) used.
formulations.VFT Notes (above temp): Read from Fig 8/9 fits; T0 = Tg - 25C used for comparison, but values vary with T.
formulations.Notes: KTFSI prepared from (CF3SO2)2NH and CF3SO2NH(CH2)3OCH3 with K2CO3 in acetonitrile, dried under high vacuum at 130 C. Forms crystalline compounds (10/1, 1.5/1) with PEO. Miscible at elevated temperatures.
